article.title: How Do You Pay for Alcohol Delivery in London?
article.body:
How Do You Pay for Alcohol Delivery in London?

At Drinks House 247, every order is placed and paid for online at checkout, by card or PayPal. There is no cash on delivery and orders are not taken by phone. Paying in advance keeps deliveries fast and safe, lets gift senders pay for someone else, and leaves the driver free to focus on the age check at the door.

Ordering drinks to your door should be quick, and the payment step is where most questions come up. Can you pay the driver in cash? Can someone else pay for a gift? What happens if the card is declined? This guide explains how payment works and why it is set up the way it is.

How do you pay?

  1. Choose your drinks on the website and go to checkout.
  2. Enter the delivery address, which can be your own or someone else's.
  3. Pay online by card or PayPal. Any other payment options available are shown at checkout.
  4. You receive an order confirmation by email, and the order is prepared for delivery.

Delivery charges, if any apply to your order, are shown at checkout before you pay, so there are no surprises at the door.

Can you pay the driver in cash?

No. Drinks House 247 does not offer cash on delivery, and drivers do not carry card machines. All payment happens online before the order leaves.

Question Answer
Cash on delivery?No
Card payment to the driver?No; pay online at checkout
Phone orders?No; orders are placed online. The phone line is for questions and order help
Card or PayPal at checkout?Yes
Paying for someone else's delivery?Yes; the sender pays and the recipient pays nothing

Why no cash on delivery?

  • Safety. Drivers working through the night are safer when they are not carrying cash.
  • Speed. With payment already complete, a handover takes moments, which helps keep London deliveries to a typical 30 to 45 minutes.
  • The age check comes first. At the door, the driver's job is to confirm the person accepting the order is 18 or over. Without a payment to manage, that check gets their full attention.
  • Gifts work properly. Prepaid orders mean a recipient is never asked to pay for their own present.

How do gift orders work?

When you send drinks to someone else, you pay at checkout and enter their address for delivery. Add a gift message so they know who it is from. The recipient does not pay anything; they only need to be 18 or over and, if they look under 25, show photo ID under the Challenge 25 policy.

What does the driver check at the door?

Payment is already done, so the driver checks two things: that the order is going to the right address, and that the person accepting it is 18 or over. Anyone who looks under 25 is asked for photo ID such as a passport or driving licence. If nobody at the address can show they are over 18, the driver cannot hand over the order, even though it has been paid for.

What if a payment is declined?

If a card is declined at checkout, the order is not placed and nothing is sent. Check the card details and billing address, try another card, or use PayPal. Your bank may also block an unfamiliar online payment for security; approving it in your banking app usually solves this.

Is it safe to pay online?

Card details are entered on the secure checkout, never given to a driver or read out over the phone. Look for the padlock in your browser's address bar and the correct web address, drinkshouse247.co.uk, before entering payment details. Be wary of anyone contacting you to take payment by phone or message; genuine orders are always paid through the website.

Can a business order and pay online?

Yes. Businesses order the same way, online at checkout. Deliveries to London business addresses can arrive the same day when ordered by 4pm, which suits office celebrations and client gifts. For larger or regular orders, contact the team to discuss what you need.

What about refunds and changes?

If something is wrong with your order, contact the team using the details on the contact page as soon as possible. Because payment was made online, any agreed refund goes back to the original payment method.

Frequently asked questions

Can I pay cash for alcohol delivery in London?

Not with Drinks House 247. All orders are paid online at checkout by card or PayPal, and drivers do not take cash or card payments.

Can I order alcohol delivery by phone?

No. Orders are placed and paid for online. The phone line is for questions and help with an existing order.

Does the recipient of a gift have to pay anything?

No. The sender pays at checkout. The recipient only needs to be 18 or over and show ID if they look under 25.

Why don't alcohol delivery drivers take cash?

Prepaid orders keep drivers safer, make handovers faster, and let them focus on the legal age check at the door.

Ordering

See how alcohol delivery works and which areas we cover, how to send a gift anywhere in the UK, or get help on our contact page. For more on the age check, read delivery safety and age verification or browse our alcohol delivery questions answered.

Deliveries are to over-18s only under our Challenge 25 policy. Please drink responsibly.
article.summary: Every order is paid online at checkout by card or PayPal, with no cash on delivery. Why, how gift orders are paid by the sender, and what happens at the door.
